description: This file defines a Java class 'FieldSourcer' that extends ASM's 'FieldVisitor' to generate source code for Java fields, including annotations and signatures.

classes.name: FieldSourcer
classes.description: A subclass of ASM's FieldVisitor that generates Java source code for a field, including annotations, attributes, and type information.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Handles visiting a field annotation; writes annotation in source format.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Handles visiting a field attribute; writes attribute info as a comment.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the field source generation, writing type, name, and semicolon.
